title: Laundry & Major Appliances Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=thinq:washer) OR (index=personal sourcetype=thinq:dryer)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="thinq:washer","primary",sourcetype="thinq:dryer","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from thinq:washer and thinq:dryer to see whether two laundry feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `thinq:washer` and `thinq:dryer` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main laundry data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
